purpose: Teach: 書面/代理人/不調/派閥/期末/行き先/続行/後押し

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業期、本気で、絶対、書面、絶対、なし、絶対、信用、絶対、で、絶対、商売したぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: When I was starting out, I did business on nothing but trust and handshakes. No paperwork, no middlemen. Pure commitment.
lines.style: Slow, measured cadence. Each phrase lands with quiet weight. Voice carries the solidity of decades past. Not boasting—stating fact. Slight pause before the closing thought.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが、本気で、絶対、代理人、絶対、立てる、絶対、判断、絶対、ありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I carry forward the principle you lived by—that judgment and trust matter more than protocol. I'm grateful for that foundation.
lines.style: Respectful, almost formal. Careful articulation. Voice steady and grounded. Speaking to both the elder and to something larger than the moment. Genuine without ceremony.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、不調、絶対、にも、絶対、お休みしなかったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Even when things were difficult, I never let myself step back from the work. I was there with my people, through all of it.
lines.style: Voice softens slightly. Tone of quiet pride mixed with old exhaustion. Pace unhurried. The weight of those years present in the breath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さん、本気で、絶対、派閥、絶対、を、絶対、嫌う、絶対、お考え、絶対、引き継いでおります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I've kept your conviction close—that factions and politics have no place in how we lead. That loyalty goes to the work, not the ladder.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured tone. Speaking as if turning something over in his mind. Respectful cadence. Not defensive, but acknowledging something earned.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、期末、絶対、最後まで、絶対、社員と、絶対、いたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: When the quarter ended, I stayed beside my team until the last task was done. That's what you showed me.
lines.style: Voice quieter now, almost tender. Each sentence deliberate. The cadence of someone remembering and honoring a memory. Slight breath before the final phrase.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが、本気で、絶対、初出張の、絶対、行き先、絶対、忘れません、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I remember where you first sent me—that assignment. I've never forgotten the trust it represented. I try to give that same trust to others.
lines.style: Warm but precise. Voice carries recognition and gratitude. Pacing is deliberate. Sounds like someone keeping a vow quietly, without fanfare.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、苦境、絶対、でも、絶対、事業、絶対、続行、絶対、貫いたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Even in crisis, I pushed the business forward. I didn't falter. You taught me that resilience isn't about comfort—it's about seeing it through.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Steady resolve beneath the surface. Voice carries hard-won understanding. Each statement lands with quiet conviction. Slight deepening on the final phrase.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの、本気で、絶対、若手、絶対、後押し、絶対、姿勢、絶対、引き継いでおります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The way you mentored the younger people, always believing in them—I've made that my own way of leading. That's your legacy in how I work.
lines.style: Warm and grounded. Closing tone, as if drawing threads together. Voice softens at the close. Sincere without sentiment. The sound of someone who has lived into what was given to him.
